result.execution_scope: Actual controller source transpiled in isolated VM with synthetic API/storage. No application source edit or network/browser operation.

error.message: Server returned an invalid task acknowledgement

independent_reproduction.method: Actual taskDetailAutosave.ts transpiled via existing TypeScript and loaded in isolated Node VM with synthetic API/storage. No source edits, HTTP/network/provider/browser operation.
steps: Create controller with same-owner completed task revision2. Return a deferred API transition acknowledgement. Call transition(next),flush; assert sent action=reopen,to_state=next,expected_revision=2.
Positive control: resolve valid reopened task revision3 without a canonical sync. Controller reaches saved/error=null.

Race: before resolving same valid acknowledgement, call controller.sync(reopened canonical revision3), then resolve acknowledgement. Controller ends failed/error.kind=protocol although canonical task is already next/revision3.
Both scenarios use identical DTO shape and legitimate acknowledgement; only interleaving differs. Module source is byte-identical to integrated main.

finding.scope: Existing task autosave correctness, outside accepted auth implementation scope
finding.actual_behavior: sync() can advance mutable baseline while a mutation acknowledgement is pending. dispatch then validates that acknowledgement against the advanced baseline revision/state, rejecting the same valid current acknowledgement as non-monotonic/protocol-invalid.
finding.impact: The UI can report save unverified for an operation already validly committed and observed as canonical; no unauthorized account access or data disclosure was demonstrated.
finding.owner_disposition: Root explicitly keeps task production/guards/button timeout unchanged in this auth branch and requests known-baseline issue disclosure even if canonical retries pass. Do not call it resolved or merely timing.
finding.correction_constraint: Any separately scoped task fix must preserve receipt shape/identity/revision/state validation and account boundaries; relaxing guard or visibility timeout is not an evidenced repair.
